title: sync: remaining CLI-dependent app-server coverage above core (#2274)
body:
Compile pass (sync-compile3, #1532): first test runs of the non-core crates that now build on `sync/upstream-rust-v0.167.0` (glitch, Rust 1.99.1, V8 152.2.0 archive verified; sync-tree + PRs #2265/#2268/#2273/#2275). Most of these crates did not compile on the sync branch before, so there is no sync baseline; each failure below is a row to resolve, not a reason to skip.

| Crate | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---|---|---|
| codex-diagnostics | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-thread-store | 279 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-exec-server (lib / exec_process / others) | 445 / 54 / 247 | 4 / 7 / 0 | 0 / 11 / 1 |
| codex-memories-write | 61 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-chatgpt (lib + all) | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-app-server-client | 46 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-app-server-transport | 175 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-apply-patch | 97 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-browser-isolation | 20 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-core-plugins | 522 | 0 | 1 |
| codex-exec (lib / all) | 84 / 123 | 0 / 5 | 0 |
| codex-exec-server-cli (lib / standalone) | 32 / 0 | 1 / 1 | 0 |
| codex-external-agent-migration | 173 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-goal-extension | 36 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-guardian-context | 58 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-history-notes-extension (lib, ext / image_model_input) | 9 / 0 | 0 / 1 | 0 |
| codex-linux-sandbox (lib / all) | 255 / 116 | 0 / 3 | 0 / 3 |
| codex-mxc-sandbox | 19 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-rollout-trace | 75 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-skills-extension | 222 | 0 | 1 |
| codex-telegram | 155 | 0 | 0 |
| codex-app-server (lib / suite `all`) | 451 / 1569 | 3 / 172 | 0 / 2 |

**Failures, by cause**
- exec-server: see #2270 (same failures on the unmodified base).
- **linux-sandbox (security-owned)**: `user_namespaces::issue_826_every_process_in_the_sandbox_is_filtered` sees 5 / 1 seccomp filters on PID 1 where the test expects own+2 / own: the filter is present but upstream's sandbox now stacks extra filters, so the count expectation needs a security-owner decision. `lifecycle::a_command_without_bubblewrap_{gets_its_groups_signals_once,keeps_its_terminal}` (FullDisk: no interrupt / outlived its terminal hangup).
- exec `all`: `provider_key_env::{shell_command,login_shell_command}_does_not_inherit_provider_keys` (drive the `shell_command` tool upstream removed: "unsupported call"), `plugin_sync_shutdown::exec_stops_the_plugin_sync_git_{before_it_exits,when_turn_start_fails}`, `daybreak::exec_custom_provider_daybreak_uses_capability` (expected stderr message changed).
- exec-server-cli: the help snapshot now says `~/.corbanu/config.toml` (main's branding; re-accept after reading); `standalone_initializes_reports_version_and_runs_helpers` gets executorVersion "0.0.0" vs package 0.1.48 (build-info version not initialised in the standalone executor).
- history-notes `image_model_input` snapshot diff (re-accept after reading).
- app-server lib: `in_process::tests::process_output_and_exit_survive_a_full_in_process_event_queue`, `gateway_oauth_tests::gateway_oauth_login_updates_existing_requests`, `thread_lifecycle_tests::thread_start_unloads_after_requesting_connection_closes_during_mcp_startup`.
- app-server suite (172): broad areas: guardian_v2 code-mode/history (~30), thread_sample (~20), selected_capability_stack/executor_mcp (~15), request_permissions, model_list, misalignment_policy, workspace_routing, daybreak_access, imagegen, command_exec, code_mode_host, named_session_account_backend, sqlite_recovery and others; some need helper binaries (`test_stdio_server` not built by `cargo test -p codex-app-server`). Main's #2177 confirmation tests: 21 of 27 pass (the confirmation port in #2273 works); 4 that expect an approved probe's write (`f05_pending_accept`, `confirmation_loosening`/`tightening`, `f06_f09 restricted_to_full`, `f07 end_restricted`) fail since the probes moved from the removed `shell_command` tool to `exec_command`: approval/escalation semantics differ and the probes need porting.

Full logs on glitch: `~/corbanu-rtx/sc3-test-{pr1,pr2c,a,b}.log`. Refs #1532, #1628, #1631.
